name: @own-my-budget/ai-orchestrator
description: Pure, runtime-agnostic decision types, validators, confidence policy, redaction, and circuit-breaker logic for the Claude + Jev orchestration layer. Zero I/O. Edge Functions (Deno) keep a hand-maintained duplicate of the small type surface they need, the same way supabase/functions/_shared/feature-limits.ts duplicates packages/core — Deno can't import workspace packages at deploy time. This package is the Source of Truth and the one that's actually Jest-tested in CI.
